mapper.insert: insert into treatment_records (house_id, rabbit_id, start_date, diagnosis, drug, dose, days, next_review_date, status, remark, request_id, create_by, update_by) values (#{houseId}, #{rabbitId}, #{startDate}, #{diagnosis}, #{drug}, #{dose}, #{days}, #{nextReviewDate}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{requestId}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.select: select id, house_id, rabbit_id, start_date, diagnosis, drug, dose, days, next_review_date, status, remark, request_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from treatment_records where house_id = #{houseId} and rabbit_id = #{rabbitId} and request_id = #{requestId} limit 1
mapper.update: update treatment_records set status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where house_id = #{houseId} and id = #{id}
mapper.select: select tr.id, tr.house_id, tr.rabbit_id, tr.start_date, tr.diagnosis, tr.drug, tr.dose, tr.days, tr.next_review_date, tr.status, tr.remark, tr.request_id, tr.create_by, tr.create_time, tr.update_by, tr.update_time from treatment_records tr inner join rabbits r on r.house_id = tr.house_id and r.id = tr.rabbit_id and r.is_active = true where tr.house_id = #{houseId} and tr.status = 'OPEN' and tr.next_review_date is not null and tr.next_review_date <= #{now} order by tr.next_review_date asc, tr.id asc
